scope: Local model capability study using real Mooter buildPayload and endpoint guard. NOT installed connector/full Moo Pilot A/B. No tools granted to models; synthetic inputs only.

cases.prompt: Extract the ticket ID from: Customer requests assistance regarding ticket SEN-4827. Return the ID string. Return only JSON with one key answer.
Normalize this list by trimming and lowercasing; keep order and duplicates: [" OPS ","Legal","ops "]. Return only JSON with one key answer.

Return alphabetically sorted IDs of OPEN tickets with priority >=3: [{"id":"C","state":"OPEN","priority":4},{"id":"A","state":"CLOSED","priority":5},{"id":"B","state":"OPEN","priority":3},{"id":"D","state":"OPEN","priority":2}]. Return only JSON with one key answer.

Return a sorted unique list of owners with an overdue task. Today day=12; overdue means due<12 AND done=false. Tasks: Ana due11 done=false; Ben due12 done=false; Ana due9 done=false; Cam due8 done=true; Dan due10 done=false. Return only JSON with one key answer.

Sum signed amounts for APPROVED rows only, excluding rows with refunded=true. Rows: amount120 APPROVED refunded=false; amount80 PENDING refunded=false; amount-20 APPROVED refunded=false; amount60 APPROVED refunded=true; amount45 APPROVED refunded=false. Return a number. Return only JSON with one key answer.

Events are ordered. Deduplicate by event ID keeping the FIRST occurrence, then sum delta. Events: id=a delta=8; id=b delta=-3; id=a delta=50; id=c delta=7; id=b delta=4; id=d delta=-2. Return a number. Return only JSON with one key answer.

Compute earliest completion time with unlimited parallel workers and finish-to-start dependencies: A duration3 no dependencies; B duration5 no dependencies; C duration4 depends A; D duration2 depends A,B; E duration6 depends C,D; F duration1 depends E. Time starts at0. Return final finish time as a number. Return only JSON with one key answer.

Policy: allow iff user tenant equals document tenant AND device is managed AND (document public OR user in document department) AND no explicit deny. Deny overrides all. Return sorted allowed IDs: 1 userT=A docT=A managed=true public=false member=true deny=false; 2 userT=A docT=B managed=true public=true member=true deny=false; 3 userT=A docT=A managed=false public=true member=true deny=false; 4 userT=A docT=A managed=true public=true member=false deny=true; 5 userT=A docT=A managed=true public=true member=false deny=false. Return only JSON with one key answer.

Select a subset maximizing total value subject to cost<=10. E requires A; B and C cannot coexist. Tie-break by lower total cost then lexicographically smallest concatenated sorted IDs. Items [ID,cost,value]: [["A",4,8],["B",3,7],["C",5,11],["D",2,4],["E",6,13],["F",1,1]]. Return only the sorted selected ID array as answer. Return only JSON with one key answer.

Items [ID,cost,value]: [["A",3,6],["B",4,9],["C",2,4],["D",5,12],["E",1,2],["F",6,13]]. Return only the sorted selected ID array as answer. Return only JSON with one key answer.

quality: Exact JSON answer against deterministic oracle, equal weight 10 tasks per profile. Levels are author-assigned, not validated difficulty scale.
hardware: Capacity targets, not GPU caps or emulated devices. CPU-only request separately verified by runtime residency. No Mac benchmark.
cost: Local API charge 0; electricity, hardware amortization, human effort and subscription cost unknown. No commercial price-per-prompt or market ranking.
comparison: Fixed-model profiles are native baselines; Mooter payload preserves identical input. Any offline capacity-aware policy replay is a PROPOSED policy, not deployed routing or independent new calls.
